title.zh: 宣布每年 6 月 18 日为伊富高省特别非工作假日（名称为伊富高成立纪念日），以纪念Founding周年纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring June 18 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Ifugao, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary, to Be Known as the Ifugao Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 18 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Ifugao, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary, to Be Known as the Ifugao Foundation Day
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 18 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Ifugao với tên gọi "the Ifugao Foundation Day", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 18 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในจังหวัด Ifugao ในชื่อ "the Ifugao Foundation Day" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 18 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Provinsi Ifugao dengan nama "the Ifugao Foundation Day", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 18 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Wilayah Ifugao dengan nama "the Ifugao Foundation Day", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11101_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: June 18 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Ifugao, in commemoration of its founding anniversary, to be known as the "Ifugao Foundation Day".
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
